jp: ここまでをセーブしますか？
世界は混沌をはらんでいた
en: Since the creation of heaven and earth, the world has carried chaos in its womb.

jp: 力を持つ者と持たざる者
en: White wings and black wings. Light and dark. Those with power and those without.

jp: ありとあらゆる相対因子が
憎み合い、奪い合い、殺し合う
en: Every opposing factor hating, plundering, killing one another: a world designed so.

jp: 互いを削り合う緋色の日々が続き
ひととき勝利を収めた者は
en: Crimson days of grinding each other down wore on, and those who won a passing victory

jp: 彼（か）の者との約束通り、
en: named themselves angels and, as promised to that One, came into their ripeness.

jp: しかし、擦（す）りあい傷ついた
羽根は地に墜ちて返らず
世界樹とともに減じ始めた
en: But wings chafed and torn fell to earth, never to return, waning with the World Tree.
And once more, the promised time comes.
O fragile, brittle ones, who have not even wings,

jp: 未来を託すにはあまりに未成熟
en: far too unripe to be entrusted with the future.

jp: 能わずとも・・為さねばならぬ
en: And yet, though it be beyond you... it must be done.

jp: 痛いほどにあふれるこの世界
en: A world brimming, painfully, with beauty and ugliness, for young souls to meet.
The waking of the one who lies in brief slumber is near.
